vertebrae.utils.validation
==========================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.utils.validation

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Validation helpers for dense and sparse embeddings.



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.utils.validation.ensure_2d_numeric_array
   vertebrae.utils.validation.ensure_dense_numeric_2d
   vertebrae.utils.validation.ensure_numeric_matrix
   vertebrae.utils.validation.ensure_sparse_numeric_2d

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: ensure_2d_numeric_array(value, name)

   Validate a dense 2D numeric array.

   :param value: Array-like value to validate.
   :param name: Human-readable name used in error messages.

   :returns: A NumPy array with numeric, finite values.

   :raises ValueError: If `value` is sparse, non-2D, non-numeric, or non-finite.


.. py:function:: ensure_dense_numeric_2d(value, name)

   Validate dense 2D numeric output from an extractor.

   :param value: Array-like value to validate.
   :param name: Human-readable name used in error messages.

   :returns: A dense numeric NumPy array.

   :raises ValueError: If `value` is sparse or invalid.


.. py:function:: ensure_numeric_matrix(value, name, allow_sparse = True)

   Validate dense or sparse numeric 2D embeddings.

   :param value: Dense array-like object or scipy sparse matrix.
   :param name: Human-readable name used in error messages.
   :param allow_sparse: Whether sparse matrices are accepted.

   :returns: A NumPy array for dense input, or the original sparse matrix for sparse input.

   :raises ValueError: If the matrix is not 2D, numeric, finite, or sparse is disallowed.


.. py:function:: ensure_sparse_numeric_2d(value, name)

   Validate a scipy sparse numeric matrix.

   :param value: Sparse matrix to validate.
   :param name: Human-readable name used in error messages.

   :returns: The original sparse matrix.

   :raises ValueError: If the sparse matrix is non-2D, non-numeric, or non-finite.


.. py:function:: sparse_to_dense(value, name, max_dense_bytes)

   Convert a sparse matrix to dense after checking memory size.

   :param value: Sparse matrix to densify.
   :param name: Human-readable name used in error messages.
   :param max_dense_bytes: Maximum allowed dense allocation size.

   :returns: A dense numeric NumPy array.

   :raises ValueError: If the dense representation would exceed `max_dense_bytes`.


.. py:function:: estimate_dense_nbytes(value)

   Estimate bytes required to represent a matrix densely.


.. py:function:: is_sparse_matrix(value)

   Return whether `value` is a scipy sparse matrix.


.. py:function:: l2_normalize_rows(value)

   L2-normalize rows of a dense numeric array.
